cards.title: Krylov Complexity Phase Transition Found in Dicke Light-Matter Model
cards.why_it_matters: Complexity measures like Krylov complexity are becoming important evals for quantum chaos and thermalization — this result showing a sharp transition in complexity phase diagrams is directly relevant if you track quantum ML or quantum computing foundations.
cards.summary: Researchers map the Krylov complexity phase diagram of the Dicke model (two-level atoms coupled to a cavity photon mode). Varying coupling strength g triggers a sharp transition: the slope of Krylov complexity C_K changes suddenly, coinciding with a jump in Krylov entropy. Wave-packet dynamics in Krylov space reveal confinement vs. deconfinement regimes, analogized to gravitational spaghettification.
